description: Defines data types and related operations for tensor elements in the Torch JIT Tensorexpr module, including the Dtype class, ElementType enum, and associated functions.

classes.name: Dtype
classes.description: Represents data types for tensor elements, supporting scalar types and lanes for vectorization.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs a Dtype object to an output stream.

methods.name: ToDtype
methods.description: Converts a C++ type or ScalarType to a Dtype object.

methods.name: promoteTypes
methods.description: Promotes two Dtypes to a common type.

methods.name: BinaryOpDtype
methods.description: Determines the resulting Dtype of a binary operation between two Dtypes.
